name: Yin Keng
bio: Yin Keng (c. 511–c. 563), courtesy name Zijian, came from Wuwei and was famed from boyhood for his five-character verse, said to have recited poems and rhapsodies by heart at five. He served the Liang as a military official under the Prince of Xiangdong and, under the Chen, held posts in the household of the Prince of Shixing and rose to be governor of Jinling and an attendant gentleman of the court.

He is remembered as a master of the landscape poem and the poem of parting, in the close, balanced couplets of the Liang and Chen court style. The Tang poet Du Fu praised him, naming him beside He Xun as a model for poets who care for finished lines. The five poems given here are taken from juan 109 of Feng Weine's Gushi ji, as transcribed in the Siku quanshu.

poems.title: 渡青草湖 (Du Qingcao hu)
poems.author: Yin Keng
poems.text:
洞庭春溜滿
平湖錦㠶張
沅水桃花色
湘流杜若香
穴去茅山近
江連巫峽長
帶天澄逈碧
映日動浮光
行舟逗逺樹
度鳥息危檣
滔滔不可測
一葦詎能航

poems.title: 廣陵岸送北使 (Guangling an song bei shi)
poems.author: Yin Keng
poems.text:
行人引去節
送客艤歸艫
即是觀濤處
仍為郊贈衢
汀洲浪已息
䢴江路不紆
亭嘶背櫪馬
檣囀向風烏
海上春雲襍
天際晚㠶孤
離舟對零雨
别渚望飛鳬
定知能下淚
非但一楊朱

poems.title: 江津送劉光祿不及 (Jiangjin song Liu Guanglu bu ji)
poems.author: Yin Keng
poems.text:
依然臨送渚
長望倚河津
鼓聲隨聽絶
㠶勢與雲隣
泊處空餘鳥
離亭已散人
林寒正下葉
釣晚欲收綸
如何相背逺
江漢與城闉

poems.title: 和傅郎歲暮還湘州 (He Fu lang suimu huan Xiangzhou)
poems.author: Yin Keng
poems.text:
蒼茫嵗欲晚
辛苦客方行
大江静猶浪
扁舟獨且征
棠枯綘葉盡
蘆凍白花輕
戍人寒不望
沙禽逈未驚
湘波各深淺
空軫念歸情

poems.title: 開善寺 (Kaishan si)
poems.author: Yin Keng
poems.text:
鷲嶺春光遍
王城野望通
登臨情不極
蕭散趣無窮
鶯隨入戸樹
花逐下山風
棟裏歸雲白
牕外落暉紅
古石何年臥
枯樹幾春空
淹留昔未及
幽桂在芳叢
